content: Main options for rendering DXF in-browser: dxf-viewer (vagran, WebGL/three.js, purpose-built for large real-world DXF files, ~144k downloads/month, actively maintained) bundles its own internal parser (no dxf-parser dependency) and has no React bindings; three-dxf (stale since 2021) pairs with dxf-parser + three.js; for mid-fidelity 2D rendering with per-entity selection, a Konva/react-konva-based custom renderer consuming dxf-parser output directly is simpler and avoids double-parsing.
